limitations: Same 2024-2026 dates already investigated, not an out-of-sample forecast
Historical Bitstamp BTC/USD and ETH/USD, not OKX USDC
Fees and slippage assumed, no order fills and no tax
Cash-window attribution uses future prices ONLY for evaluating past positions, never for making a decision
Cash log timing identities are theoretical before fees; net portfolios incur fee and slip
Last cash windows are censored at final close; do not classify as a completed sale-rebuy cycle

results.source: Bitstamp native BTC/USD and ETH/USD, 1310 UTC calendar days each

method_definitions.hold: Buy at first test-day open, stay invested until valuation at final close
method_definitions.c2: EMA10/30 raw state must persist for 2 daily closes before both entries and exits
method_definitions.c3: EMA10/30 raw state must persist for 3 daily closes before both entries and exits
method_definitions.e1n2: EMA10/30 one bearish close to exit and two bullish closes to enter

results.note: Yearly performance is the actual continuous portfolio change, never a yearly reset.
